name: steep_edge_corners
note: Corner gaps only: where two cells >= 30 deg meet at a corner with gentle ground both other sides, the steeper gentle cell takes the cheaper steep cost. Result (96 tours vs control): 12 moved >50 m, 6 >250 m - near-ties tipped where the line used a corner gap (1060, 1096, 1012). Totals flat: on >=30 deg +0.3%, within 10 m -4.7%, exp/km +2.4% (11 up / 11 down). Closes the leak; does not by itself move routes off edges.
